title: Duplicate script name
description: Error-prone rule — two or more scripts sharing the same name within one file. A frequent copy-paste artefact that makes "call script by name" ambiguous.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Duplicate names make the solution confusing and can misroute scripts called by name.
rule.remediation: Rename or merge the duplicates so each script name is unique per file.
